name: niceludo
description: NiceLudo - a premium, offline, provably-fair Ludo board game for Android and iOS (React Native CLI).

scripts.ios: npm run version:sync && react-native run-ios --scheme NiceLudo-Debug --mode Debug
scripts.ios:release: npm run version:sync && react-native run-ios --scheme NiceLudo-Release --mode Release
scripts.pods: npm run version:sync && cd ios && bundle exec pod install
scripts.build:apk: npm run version:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:aab: npm run version:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ipa: npm run version:sync && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace NiceLudo.xcworkspace -scheme NiceLudo-Release -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/NiceLudo.xcarchive archive
